data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 was GBP 61.371m. The gross prior-year development was adverse (strengthening) of approximately GBP 6.256m (around 10.2% of opening reserves), driven by adverse claims development in older underwriting years (principally the 2014 underwriting year as shown in the gross claims development table). No specific named catastrophe or single large loss is identified as the cause in the text.
raw_causal_phrases: claims development tables are shown on an underwriting year basis

The outstanding claims provision is based on the estimated ultimate cost of all claims incurred but not settled at the reporting date, whether reported or not, together with related claims handling costs and reduction for the expected value of salvage and other recoveries.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position comparative column (2015). Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development table (triangle) by comparing the 2014 column's current estimate (131,412) to its previous diagonal (one year later 125,156) giving +6,256 (GBP 000) = GBP 6.256m. No explicit narrative sentence quantifying gross prior year movement was found; the figure is derived from the triangle. The triangle is limited (only 2014-2016 columns) so PYD is effectively driven by movement in the 2014 underwriting year only. RITC and other arrangements referenced elsewhere may distort some development tables but no explicit RITC distortion of the 2014 triangle was identified for this calculation.
